research.title: Robustness of Image Segmentation Under Illumination Changes
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare segmentation models under controlled brightness shifts, contrast changes, and spatially uneven illumination.
Implemented image perturbation pipelines in PyTorch and analyzed classwise overlap metrics to distinguish boundary errors from missed foreground regions.

research.title: Evaluating Visual Representations for Limited-Label Classification
bullets: Planned experiments with supervisor guidance comparing frozen pretrained representations and supervised fine-tuning across controlled subsets of labeled images.
Maintained consistent data splits and preprocessing, then examined confusion matrices and nearest neighbors to characterize errors among visually similar categories.

work.title: Image Upload Validation and Processing Services
bullets: Implemented Python components for image upload validation, thumbnail generation, and metadata extraction within an existing application processing pipeline.
Added regression tests for corrupted files and unsupported formats, and investigated processing failures using application logs and reproducible test inputs.

projects.title: Local Feature Matching for Planar Image Alignment
bullets: Implemented corner detection, patch descriptors, and robust homography estimation to align image pairs depicting overlapping views of planar scenes.
Compared descriptor normalization and matching criteria using reprojection error and visual inspection under changes in viewpoint, illumination, and texture.

projects.title: Comparing Classical and Learned Image Denoising
bullets: Implemented median filtering, Gaussian smoothing, and a convolutional denoising model for images corrupted by synthetic impulse and Gaussian noise.
Compared reconstruction quality using peak signal to noise ratio and structural similarity, inspecting edge preservation across noise settings.

projects.title: Image Classification with Handcrafted and Convolutional Features
bullets: Implemented histogram of oriented gradients features with a linear classifier and trained a compact convolutional network on the same image dataset.
Compared classification accuracy, training behavior, and categorywise errors using shared data splits, documenting differences on texture dominated and shape dominated examples.
